mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.outbox_event (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, CAST(payload AS text) AS payload FROM app.outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE app.outbox_event SET published_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
